method.findings: Exact canonical JSON record multiset (Counter, no deduplication): resolved rule ID, numeric security severity, result level/kind, message, all primary and related physical/logical locations, both fingerprint maps, full code flows and counts, stacks.
method.gate: Equivalent to repository inspectSarif: every result counts; block missing/nonfinite/out-of-range security-severity or numeric severity >=7; fail malformed/ambiguous rule references. Notifications are reported separately and not included in blocked finding counts.
method.locations: Resolve artifact/logical/thread-flow index references and available URI bases; preserve unresolved symbolic URI bases, complete regions, snippets, logical hierarchy, all array order and movement changes. Do not strip line numbers or runner paths.
method.notifications: Exact warning/error notification multisets from all invocation toolExecutionNotifications and toolConfigurationNotifications; resolved descriptor IDs, full normalized content, locations, exceptions and properties; preserve multiplicity.
method.text: Collapse whitespace only in SARIF text/markdown values. Preserve message IDs/arguments and resolve message-string text when needed. Canonicalize object key order.
